source_title: Hylo Open 2026, Indians in action today: Sindhu vs Pancasari, Lakshya vs Kiran George, full schedule in IST - Sportstar
source_excerpt: India will have a strong presence in the Round of 16 at the Hylo Open 2026, with five players in women’s singles and two in men’s singles advancing from the opening round. Hylo Open 2026: Sindhu beats UAE’s Bharath in 28 minutes to enter Round of 16; Ashmita exits Hylo Open 2026: Sindhu beats UAE’s Bharath in 28 minutes to enter Round of 16; Ashmita exits The two-time Olympic medallist comes into the Super 500 tournament on the back of a runner-up finish at the French Open Super 750, where she lost to World No. 1 An Se-young in the final. Hylo Open 2026: Sindhu beats UAE’s Bharath in 28 minutes to enter Round of 16; Ashmita exits storyline 1 Two-time Olympic medallist P. V. Sindhu made a commanding start, defeating the UAE’s Prakriti Bharath 21-10, 21-10 in just 28 minutes. Malvika Bansod also progressed after recovering from a game down to beat compatriot Devika Sihag in an all-Indian contest. Unnati Hooda rallied to overcome Czechia’s Tereza Švabíková, while Isharani Baruah and Anmol Kharb also secured their places in the last 16. In men’s singles, Kiran George and Lakshya Sen will lead India’s challenge after winning their respective opening-round matches. However, H. S. Prannoy, Sankar Muthusamy Subramanian and Tharun Mannepalli bowed out. Sindhu faces France’s Rosy Oktavia Pancasari next, while Lakshya takes on compatriot Kiran in an all-Indian clash.
